## Parental OpControl 0.17.17

- **My OpControl has a new About screen.** Open it from the small **About** link at the bottom of the sidebar, under the device name, or from **About** in the tray menu.
- About shows the client version and build date, the server version it is connected to, the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 summary and the full license text inside the app, the copyright line, and the OpControl logo.
- The credits list is generated at build time from the real dependency graph, so it includes Avalonia, LiveMarkdown, the Fredoka and Nunito fonts, and every other bundled package with its license.
- The installer now includes the project license, the generated third-party notices and the font license texts in `Program Files\OpControlParental\legal`.
- **The Yoga kid-view flicker is fixed.** The Yoga was still on 0.17.13, which did not have the Job 19i in-place refresh; 0.17.17 includes it, so Home, Schedule, Rules, Activity and Messages are no longer rebuilt on every 2–3 second poll.
- Both laptops are updated from the normal catalog. No Windows, PIN, family or Luna setting was changed.
